name: Trainsient
source:
A woman named Mariko waits at a train station for a person who never said she was coming. Evading local authorities and her own boredom, she continues to idle around the tracks as the sun dips, dyeing her world in hues of nostalgic pinks.

[From [url=https://dravianis.itch.io/trainsient]itch.io[/url]]
